_note: All flags false = v1, minus its purpose and instrumentation. Each flag is one place where a ruling diverged from v1; true = the ruling is in force, false = v1's behaviour. Defaults are as ruled. The set in force is stamped into a world when it is made.

_dependencies.perception_is_pull: inert with senses_narration false — v1 had no narrator to query
_dependencies.distance_per_resolution: false = v1's single scale toward one resolution
_dependencies.distance_is_descriptive: false = distance is a target the world steers toward

_not_flaggable._why: v1 core mechanics. Switching these off yields neither v1 nor any ruling — just a broken engine.
_not_flaggable.truth_written_first: truth exists before the first scene
_not_flaggable.truth_only_deepens: surfaced facts are never contradicted; causes are added beneath them
_not_flaggable.write_before_describe: consequences are written into the truth before they are narrated
_not_flaggable.resolutions_exist: a world has resolutions with costs
_not_flaggable.record_and_audit: the record is kept and is auditable afterwards
_not_flaggable.reactions_are_the_persons: the world never states what the character thinks or feels
_not_flaggable.sources_that_lie: some sources are unreliable, and how they are unreliable is written
_not_flaggable.people_made_before_they_speak: a person is made in full before they say anything
_not_flaggable.growth_from_decisions: the world grows only from what the person decides
_not_flaggable.never_a_test_never_a_game: no game-master register, no scoring, no quests
_not_flaggable.never_reads_engagement: the world never adapts to how interested the person seems

_removed_unconditionally._why: v1's purpose and instrumentation. Not flags — gone.
